truth_contract.rollup_rule: A scope containing more than one state reports 'mixed'. Roll-up never promotes to the strongest member.

truth_contract.disclosure: The evidence page for the kitchen scope is withheld from publication. An unshown source is not a source, so the kitchen reads unresolved alongside the other two rooms. The 3D geometry is a review aid, not production segmentation or as-built geometry.

standards: 2010 ADA Standards for Accessible Design — knee/toe clearance, work surface height, faucets, exposed pipes, clear floor space
UFAS 4.34.6.5 — kitchen sinks in accessible dwelling units: bowl depth and knee space
accessibility.citation_correction: An earlier revision cited '2010 ADA 606.6' for the 6.5 in bowl depth. Section 606 ends at 606.5 and the 2010 ADA Standards contain no sink-depth requirement at all. The governing figure is UFAS 4.34.6.5. Verified against access-board.gov.
accessibility.height_datum: workSurfaceHeight is the FINISHED TOP SURFACE — the plane 606.3 measures ('rim or counter, whichever is higher'). The counter slab sits inside that figure. An earlier revision treated it as the cabinet carcass and stacked a 55 mm slab on top, putting the governed surface at 36.17 in while the readout claimed 34.0 in.
accessibility.margin_policy: Every clearance reports a signed margin in inches, not a pass/fail. Margins under 1 in are flagged: at these breakpoints a pass with zero slack is a shop-drawing risk, and the 34 in surface over a 6.5 in bowl leaves exactly 0.5 in of knee clearance by design.
corrections_applied: Work surface default moved from 0.91 m (35.8 in) to a finished 34 in
Continuous base-cabinet run under the sink replaced with a knee-clearance void
Height datum corrected from cabinet carcass to finished top surface
Bowl-depth citation corrected from a nonexistent ADA 606.6 to UFAS 4.34.6.5
Knee depth raised from ADA 306.3's 11 in floor to the UFAS kitchen figure of 19 in
Toe depth corrected from 6 in (a maximum-protrusion reading) to the 17 in minimum
Compliance readout now measures the built geometry instead of the input parameter
accessibility.note: Accessibility figures are derived from published ADA and UFAS sections, which are checkable without any project drawing. They are unaffected by the evidence withdrawal.

runtime.routing: hash routes over component addresses; #/building-a/floor-02 is the whole unit, #/building-a/floor-02/room-204 focuses a room within it
runtime.parametric: Dimension sliders removed this pass. Dimensions are pinned to standard, mutually compatible figures; the RoomViewer keeps its setParam API for when they return as viewing adjustments.
